style: Screenprinted paper collage and argument diagrams
provider: Built-in image generation and deterministic SVG diagrams
note: Pictures support interpretation of the editable lesson text; they are not standalone evidence or answer keys. Numerical records and named practice stories are fictional. Read each sort in its stated context. Educator review is pending.

sources.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: square AlloPack lesson illustration. A quiet small school library interior, book shelves, a round reading table and several chairs, with afternoon light through windows. No people. Screenprinted paper collage with layered geometric shapes and warm teal and ochre ink. All book spines completely blank, no signage. Text-free: no writing, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Focus on the stated lesson objects; do not add students, decorative badges, explanatory arrows or captions. Keep the subject complete and easy to identify at small size.
sources.alt: A paper-collage library has book shelves, a round table and empty reading chairs in afternoon light.
sources.caption: The fictional library proposal asks for later opening hours. A picture establishes the setting; attendance records, costs and a clear explanation are needed to evaluate the proposal.

assets.prompt: Text-free instructional diagram: Three gold supports point upward to one teal statement box.
assets.alt: Three gold supports point upward to one teal statement box.
assets.caption: An argument connects supporting reasons and evidence to a claim. The number of boxes is an organizer, not a required number of reasons.

assets.prompt: Text-free instructional diagram: A large teal speech bubble is empty on a cream background.
assets.alt: A large teal speech bubble is empty on a cream background.
assets.caption: A claim is the statement being put forward. The blank bubble is a place for editable wording, not evidence by itself.

assets.prompt: Text-free instructional diagram: A schematic page has a highlighted middle line and a magnifying-glass outline beside it.
assets.alt: A schematic page has a highlighted middle line and a magnifying-glass outline beside it.
assets.caption: Locate the information offered as support and check its source. The bars represent text; use actual words and observations from the activity.

assets.prompt: Text-free instructional diagram: A gold plank connects two separated teal supports.
assets.alt: A gold plank connects two separated teal supports.
assets.caption: The left support represents evidence, the right support the claim, and the plank the reasoning that connects them. Explain the actual connection and its limits; the analogy does not prove that an argument is sound.

assets.prompt: Text-free instructional diagram: Teal and coral speech bubbles face one another with arrows running both ways.
assets.alt: Teal and coral speech bubbles face one another with arrows running both ways.
assets.caption: State an opposing claim fairly and respond with reasons. Opposite viewpoints need not have equally strong evidence.

assets.prompt: Text-free instructional diagram: A schematic page is enclosed by two balanced gold brackets.

assets.caption: Describe the source fairly and accurately. A neutral tone alone does not guarantee an unbiased selection of facts.

assets.prompt: Text-free instructional diagram: A red heart sits inside a teal speech bubble.
assets.alt: A red heart sits inside a teal speech bubble.
assets.caption: The heart represents a personal judgment or preference. Opinions about public choices can be argued for; liking something alone does not settle a proposal.
